oliver (auditor): Hi team — requesting an evidence bundle for the RBAC change that closed CVE-2026-0421. Need: approval chain (who signed off + timestamps), the exact IAM policy diff, KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events for the window, CMK ARN/alias, and a signed chain-of-custody for the exported artifacts. Also: list of principals who can use the CMK (roles/policies) and any conditional keys (kms:ViaService, aws:SourceIp).

tara (sec): Acknowledged. We'll compile PR approvals and the terraform diff. PR is in infra-iam: https://github.com/redwoodinfra/infra-iam/pull/237 (commit b2c7d9e). Approval log: @sec_mgr 2026-03-21T08:14:02Z, @platform_ops 2026-03-21T08:20:11Z. Change summary: removed wide sts:AssumeRole for svc-external, tightened svc-inference to sts:AssumeRole only from our VPC source IP range.

nate (infra): KMS details: CMK alias="alias/redwood-prod-kms", key-id=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/1a2b3c4d-5678-90ab-cdef-111213141516. No CMK rotation during rollout; last rotation 2025-11-30. I'll pull CloudTrail events for Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/ReEncrypt.

jen (oncall): Note: rollout started 2026-03-21T08:30Z (canary), full rollout 08:45Z. We saw increased 500s on ingest-worker for ~6m during canary, reverted one node then continued. No suspicious auth failures in that period. Incident ticket INF-2026-581 created.

oliver (auditor): Please export 1h before -> 2h after the canary start (2026-03-21T07:30:00Z to 2026-03-21T10:30:00Z). Audit needs CloudTrail KMS events, CloudWatch auth/error logs for svc-* principals, and terraform plan+apply diffs. Also need a signed attestation from sec_mgr that the change was minimal privilege and separation-of-duties was observed.

nate (infra): Commands I used (sanitized):

```
# CloudTrail KMS lookup
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=GenerateDataKey --start-time 2026-03-21T07:30:00Z --end-time 2026-03-21T10:30:00Z --query Events

# Filter for Decrypts
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-03-21T07:30:00Z --end-time 2026-03-21T10:30:00Z --query Events

# CloudWatch quick filter for auth events
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /aws/ecs/auth --start-time 1711013400000 --end-time 1711018200000 --filter-pattern "svc-inference OR svc-ingest OR Unauthorized"
```

jen (oncall): I'll attach the sanitized log snapshots to the bundle. We should redact full ARNs of user emails but keep truncated principals for traceability. Auditor ok with redaction?

oliver (auditor): Redaction OK as long as truncated principal + unique id is present and we provide the mapping in the secure manifest (not in Slack). Need proof of who uploaded the bundle and S3 access logs showing retrievals.

e v i d e n c e - b o t (evidence-bot): export job queued -> s3://redwood-evidence/exports/1898765432-authz-trace-20260321.tar.gz (presigned link valid 7d). Uploader: ci-user@redwood (service principal). Manifest path: s3://redwood-evidence/manifests/1898765432-manifest.json.asc

nate (infra): I generated the tarball, computed SHA256 and signed with our release GPG key. SHA256: a4f5d9e8b1c2d3e4f567890abcde12345f67890abcdef1234567890abcdefabcd. GPG signer: 0x9F3A4B2C release@redwood (fingerprint 9F3A 4B2C 7D1E 9A0B 2C3D 4E5F 6A7B 8C9D 0E1F 2345). Uploaded manifest and detached signature to manifests/.

tara (sec): KMS key policy snapshot attached to manifest (redacted principals). I'll also include a role-to-policy mapping CSV listing the roles that include "kms:Decrypt" permission and the principal ARNs truncated to the last 8 chars.

jen (oncall): Incident timeline excerpt (for bundle):
- 2026-03-21T08:30Z canary deploy start
- 08:33Z spike in 500s on ingest-worker-2
- 08:36Z rolled back node 3 -> resolved spike
- 08:45Z proceeding to full rollout
- 09:02Z INF-2026-581 closed as no regression

oliver (auditor): Also include access policy for the S3 bucket where artifacts are stored and S3 server access logs for the object (1d retention). We need evidence of retention policy for these exports (retention duration + who can delete).

nate (infra): S3 bucket policy: only infra-ci and sec-admins group have PutObject/DeleteObject on /exports/*; manifests/ have PutObject by infra-ci and PutObjectAcl blocked. Access logs for the object uploaded at 2026-03-21T11:05:34Z: s3-access-log record will be in s3://redwood-logs/s3/2026/03/21/.. (I will add the exact log file in manifest).

tara (sec): I'll get sec_mgr to sign the attestation. Quick note: separation of duties was enforced — terraform plan was run by infra-ci, apply was approved by platform_ops and performed by infra-admin role. That combination recorded in GitHub and in our CI audit trail.

oliver (auditor): Perfect. Final deliverables expected in this thread: presigned artifact link, SHA256, GPG signature, manifest with redaction mapping (secure), S3 access logs for the object, CloudTrail KMS event export (CSV), role-to-policy CSV, and sec_mgr signed attestation. ETA?

nate (infra): I'll upload the remaining logs and the exact s3-access-log path in ~45m.

tara (sec): Sec_mgr will sign within 2 hours, adding the signed attestation to the manifest. I'll post the final presigned bundle + manifest link here when complete. :white_check_mark:
